events.name: The Island of Giant Pokémon
events.intro:
A boat pulled up on the shingle, and a ferryman asleep in it.

Out past the breakers there's an island, green and high. Something on it is moving. Something very big.

success.text: **Ferryman:** "Out there? Hm. Mind your feet. Everything there's bigger than you." He rows without looking round.
You walk on. Behind you, out at sea, something very large sighs.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Beach

remembers.notice: *You've been calm around big ones before. It shows.*

events.intro:
The boat grounds. The sand is full of prints the size of the boat.

*A Slowbro's head comes up out of the surf.* *It keeps coming up.*

It looks down at you, and at your lead, with enormous, gentle interest.

success.text: It picks your lead up, the way you'd pick up a shell. It turns it over. It sets it down, gently.

effects.text: The wrong way up. It wanders off, pleased with itself.
The right way up. It looks at you as if to say: you're calm around big ones. Then it wanders off.

success.text: You run. It follows you up the beach in three slow, curious strides, and the wave it makes knocks you flat.
Your lead vanishes into its Ball. The Slowbro stares at the place it was, for a long time. Then it sinks, disappointed.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Dry River
events.intro:
Small Pokémon at a cracked riverbed, licking the stones.

Upstream, a hill that's breathing. A giant Snorlax lies across the river. It has dammed it by lying down. Above it, a lake.

It isn't doing it on purpose. It's asleep.

success.text:
A feather, or a vine, along the sole of a foot the size of a door.

It giggles in its sleep. It rolls over. The river finds its way round it, and the small Pokémon cheer in high, tiny voices.

It takes the rest of the day. Your Ground-type digs, and digs, and the Snorlax snores on.

At sunset the water finds the channel, and goes round. Nobody woke anybody.
It wakes. It isn't pleased. When it stands, the lake comes down all at once.
You leave it. The small Pokémon watch you go.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Sea Stack
events.intro:
A giant Pidgeot, sitting on a sea stack. Small Flying-types nest on its back, in the hollow between its shoulders.

One nest has slid to the very edge. The chicks in it are crying.

The Pidgeot lowers a wing, gently, so you can look.

success.text: You hold still. It looks at you a long time. Then the wing stays down, like a ramp.
The small birds mob it at once, a storm of beaks and wings. It comes back down fast, and a little bald.
You leave it. The crying follows you a long way.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Climb
events.intro:
You climb. Its shoulders rise and fall under you as it breathes, slow as a tide.

The nest is right at the edge.

success.text:
In, out. You move with its breath. You get both hands on the nest, and slide it home.

The small birds go quiet. One of them sits on your head.

failure.text: It breathes out as you breathe in. You slide down its wing into soft feathers, and the nest stays where it was.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Trench
events.intro:
A giant Rhydon walks a border, back and forth, wearing a trench. The path crosses it.

It charges anything inside the trench.

success.text: You step in. It lowers its horn.
It costs you time, but the Rhydon never sees you.

choices.label: Wait for it to reach the far end.

success.text: It turns at the far end. You run, and you're across before it's turned back.

failure.text: Too soon. It sees you, and it comes.

events.name: Island of Giants: The Clearing
events.intro:
A giant Kabutops and a giant Tangela face each other across a clearing. Neither has moved in a day.

They're quarrelling over a nest site. It's too small for either of them.

success.text:
You walk into the clearing, and call out your whole party, and stand them in it.

It's full. Six small Pokémon, and there's no more room.

The giants look. They look at each other. They leave, in opposite directions.
The Tangela sulks. It will sulk in the clearing for a week.
The Kabutops sulks. It will sulk in the clearing for a week.
You leave them. Neither notices.

events.name: Island of Giants: The High Ground

remembers.notice: *It doesn't wait. It's already on its way down the hill.*

events.intro:
*A giant Nidoking. It's the size of a church. It's been watching you the whole way up.*

*It doesn't roar. It lowers its head until one eye is level with you, and it waits.*

success.text:
It steps aside. Then it follows you down to the beach, to see you off.

*It puts one claw in the surf, and pushes the boat out.*

effects.text: You helped the island, and its guardian saw you off.
Where the Snorlax was lying: a Leftovers.
From the Pidgeot: a feather the size of an oar, too big to carry far. From the small birds: an Egg.
From the empty clearing: a fossil.

success.text: It steps aside, slowly. It doesn't see you off.

effects.text: Where the Snorlax was lying: a Leftovers.
From the Pidgeot: a feather the size of an oar, too big to carry far. From the small birds: an Egg.
From the empty clearing: a fossil.

success.text: It rises. The ground rises with it.

win.text: Where the Snorlax was lying: a Leftovers.
From the Pidgeot: a feather the size of an oar, too big to carry far. From the small birds: an Egg.
From the empty clearing: a fossil.

lose.text: Where the Snorlax was lying: a Leftovers.
From the Pidgeot: a feather the size of an oar, too big to carry far. From the small birds: an Egg.
From the empty clearing: a fossil.

success.text: It watches you go back down the hill. It will still be here.

events.name: Island of Giants: Going Back
events.intro: Which one?

success.text: Back down to the dry river.
Back to the sea stack.
Back to the clearing.

events.name: A Footprint
events.intro:
A single enormous footprint, pressed into a field.

Nobody comments on it.

success.text: You step round it, and walk on.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus

remembers.notice: *Your season ticket gets a bow from the man at the gate. Every ride is free tonight.*
*New posters. New acts. The same band, and the same smell of sugar.*

events.intro:
*A tent, red and gold, where there was a field yesterday. A band. A smell of sugar.*

**Signor Fontaine:** "Six wonders! One night only! Possibly two! Step up, step up, the clever ones win things!"

success.text: Three tickets, free at the gate. More are ₽100 at the booth inside.
The band follows you down the road for a while, then gives up.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Big Top

remembers.notice: *Top of the bill on every poster: Tumble, by name. Mid-routine, it stops. It has seen someone in row four. It finishes the routine facing that way.*
*Lower down the bill, in smaller letters: Madame Roux, Fortunes.*
*And: The Magician. Somebody has drawn a rabbit on the poster.*

events.intro:
Sawdust, lanterns, a ring in the middle and booths all round it.

A board by the entrance: Illusions. Strength. The Track. The Jugglers. The Arena. The Mystery Tent.

success.text: Six booths, and a barker at each.
Away from the crowd, a practice ring under a single lamp.
The lights dim. The band stops.
Outside, the night is very quiet after the band.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Booths
events.intro: Mr. Mime's Illusions. Machamp's Strength Contest. Rapidash's Track.

success.text: Three Mr. Mime, side by side, each leaning on an invisible wall.
A Machamp on a box, two arms folded behind its back.
A short sandy track and three jumps.
Further round the ring.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Booths
events.intro: The Jugglers. The Arena. The Mystery Tent.

success.text: Aipom on a bench, tails twitching.
A sawdust ring and three trainers in sequins.
A small black tent with a small black curtain.
The last booths, by the exit.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: New This Year
events.intro: The newest acts, still smelling of paint.

success.text: High overhead, Ambipom swing from bar to bar by their tails, and catch each other every time. Nearly every time.
A Magmar eats a torch, and looks at you as if to say: your turn. You decline.
A Dewgong and three Lumineon in a glass tank, turning in slow rings. The crowd goes quiet.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: Mr. Mime's Illusions
events.intro:
Three Mr. Mime. Two are illusions. Only the real one's wall will hold your weight.

One ticket, and you may lean once.

success.text: You pick one.
A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: Mr. Mime's Illusions
events.intro: Left, middle or right?

success.text: You lean on the left one.

effects.text: It holds. The real Mr. Mime bows, and hands you a prize from behind its back.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.

success.text: You lean on the middle one.

effects.text: It holds. The real Mr. Mime bows, and hands you a prize from behind its back.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.

success.text: You lean on the right one.

effects.text: It holds. The real Mr. Mime bows, and hands you a prize from behind its back.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.
You fall straight through it into the sawdust. The crowd loves it.

events.name: Machamp's Strength Contest
events.intro:
Enter one Pokémon. Attack decides.

The Machamp uses only two of its four arms, to be fair.

success.text: Your strongest steps up and takes the Machamp's two hands.

effects.text: Slowly, slowly, the Machamp's arms go down. It laughs, and lets go, and hands over a Protein.
The Machamp holds it there, politely, with two arms. It doesn't even need the other two.

success.text: A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: Rapidash's Track
events.intro:
A short race beside a Rapidash. Three jumps.

Speed, and timing.

success.text: Three jumps, and three clean landings. The Rapidash nods to you at the finish.

failure.text: You clip the last jump. The Rapidash waits for you at the finish, which is somehow worse.

success.text: A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: The Jugglers
events.intro:
Keep the beat while the Aipom juggle.

Three Aipom, then five, then seven.

success.text: Three Aipom, three balls. Easy.

failure.text: A ball goes into the crowd. So does an Aipom.

success.text: A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: The Jugglers
events.intro: Five Aipom now.

success.text: Five. The crowd starts clapping along.

failure.text: The fifth Aipom catches a ball with its face.

events.name: The Jugglers
events.intro: Seven Aipom. The balls are a blur.

success.text: Seven, and not one dropped. The Aipom pile on you in celebration, and leave you a bundle of Berries.

failure.text: Ball six and ball seven meet in the middle.

events.name: The Arena
events.intro:
Three battles, one after another. One Pokémon. No switching.

Win all three and a TM is yours.

success.text: The bell rings.
A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: The Mystery Tent

remembers.notice: *This year there is a second curtain.*

events.intro:
A curtain. A silhouette behind it. A price on a card.

Its tier is shown. Its species isn't.

success.text: The card turns over.
A striped ticket, still warm from the machine.
Back under the big top. The band hasn't stopped once.

events.name: The Mystery Tent
events.intro: Behind the curtain, something shifts its weight.

success.text: The curtain goes back.
The curtain goes back.
The curtain goes back.
The silhouette sits down. You will never know.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Practice Ring

remembers.notice: *The Mime Jr. from the Understudy is here too, practising beside it. They seem to be friends.*

events.intro:
*Behind the tent, at the practice ring, something is doing a perfect routine to nobody.*

*It sees you. It drops everything.*

**A stagehand, Clover Pye:** "That's Tumble. Best we've got. Goes on, sees the faces, and can't move. Three seasons now."

choices.label: Rehearse with it, in the empty tent.

success.text:
You sit in the front row of the empty tent. Then your lead sits beside you. Then the whole party.

Six in the audience. It gets all the way through the routine.

effects.text: *Two of the three, and tonight it finishes its act to a standing crowd. It bows, falls over, and stays down, laughing.*

success.text:
During the show, it looks to the side, and you're there.

It keeps looking. It keeps going.

effects.text: *Two of the three, and tonight it finishes its act to a standing crowd. It bows, falls over, and stays down, laughing.*

success.text:
You walk on beside it. It goes badly for you and wonderfully for it.

The crowd assumes it's a clown act. The applause is enormous.

effects.text: *Two of the three, and tonight it finishes its act to a standing crowd. It bows, falls over, and stays down, laughing.*

success.text: It isn't on the bill tonight.

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Final Act

remembers.notice: *Last into the ring: Tumble. It waves at you first.*

events.intro: **Signor Fontaine:** "And NOW! The management itself! A battle! My company against your… what do you call yours? Your *friends!* How sweet! Places!"

success.text: The ringmaster sweeps his hat at the band. "Marvellous!"

win.text: Fontaine sweeps off his hat. **Signor Fontaine:** "Bravo! A season ticket: every circus after this is free. And a little something from the prop box."

success.text: The ringmaster sweeps his hat at the band. Tumble is last in line, and proud.

win.text: Fontaine sweeps off his hat. **Signor Fontaine:** "Bravo! A season ticket: every circus after this is free. And a little something from the prop box."

success.text: "Tomorrow, then! Or the next day! We are always here, until we aren't!"

events.name: The Pokémon Circus: The Final Act

remembers.notice: *Last into the ring: Tumble. It waves at you first.*

events.intro: **Signor Fontaine:** "And NOW! The management itself! And my Ambipom, who has grown since last we met! Places!"

success.text: The ringmaster sweeps his hat at the band. "Marvellous!"

win.text: Fontaine sweeps off his hat. **Signor Fontaine:** "Bravo! A season ticket: every circus after this is free. And a little something from the prop box."

success.text: The ringmaster sweeps his hat at the band. Tumble is last in line, and proud.

win.text: Fontaine sweeps off his hat. **Signor Fontaine:** "Bravo! A season ticket: every circus after this is free. And a little something from the prop box."

success.text: "Tomorrow, then! Or the next day! We are always here, until we aren't!"

events.name: The Pokémon Circus
events.intro:
After the show, the tent empties. Tumble comes out of the wings and stands at your feet.

It's holding the end of a ribbon from its act. It holds it out.

success.text: It takes the ribbon in its teeth, and comes. It brings a move from its act.
It nods. It goes back to the ring and does the whole routine again, just for you.

events.name: The {team} Hideout
events.intro:
A shuttered {front} building on the edge of town. No sign on the door.

A {grunt} is smoking by the bins. He doesn't see you. Behind him, the door is propped open with a fire extinguisher.

success.text: You step over the extinguisher. Inside it smells of floor polish and burnt coffee.

effects.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text: You walk on. Behind you the {grunt} finishes his cigarette, kicks the extinguisher, and the door swings shut.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Offices

remembers.notice: *Alert low: the office is bored. Some of them could be talked past.*
*Alert: patrols. Torches sweep the office. Nobody's talking their way past anyone now.*
*Alert 10. Every alarm in the building is going. Every Grunt left has called up one more Pokémon.*

events.intro:
Desks. A canteen with a broken kettle. Two {grunt}s arguing over a stapler.

On the staff noticeboard: *LOST: one Meowth, answers to nothing.*

success.text:
Third drawer down, under a lunch order: a File. Names, dates, a map with red pins in it.

You fold it into your jacket. The drawer squeaks shut.

effects.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text: Past the fridge, a door marked STAFF ONLY. Somebody has written *REALLY* under it.
"New starter," you say. "They sent me down to Labs." The {grunt}s shrug. Neither of them wants the stapler that much.

effects.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text: The stapler goes flying. Both of them reach for their Balls.

win.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

events.name: {team} Hideout: Behind the Canteen
events.intro:
A cupboard full of mops. Behind the mops, a cash box. Beside it, a wall of little monitors.

A tape deck under the desk, labelled *LOOP*.

success.text: Notes, coins, a voucher for a free noodle bowl. The team's petty cash. (₽1,200)
The monitors flicker, and show an empty corridor, over and over. The next two cameras see nothing.
Glass everywhere. Somewhere upstairs, a bell starts ringing. Boots on the stairs. (Alert +3)
You put the mops back the way they were.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Labs

remembers.notice: *Through the frosted glass of the locked lab, the lights are still on.*
*Alert: patrols. Torches sweep the lab floor. Nobody's talking their way past anyone now.*
*Alert 10. Every alarm in the building is going. Every Grunt left has called up one more Pokémon.*

events.intro:
Glass. Machines that hum. Scientists in white coats who don't look up.

At the end of the floor, one laboratory is locked. Beside it, one scientist is standing at a window, not working.

choices.label: Talk to the scientist at the window.

success.text: He doesn't turn round. He's been waiting for somebody, and it might as well be you.
The key turns. The door hisses.
The stairs go down to a floor that smells of straw.

effects.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text: A patrol comes round the corner. They've been looking for you.

events.name: {team} Hideout: Dr. Emmerich Aldersey
events.intro:
**Dr. Emmerich Aldersey:** "You're not staff. Good. I've been hoping someone who isn't staff would come."

**Dr. Emmerich Aldersey:** "I signed on for the research. I didn't ask what it was for. I've started asking."

success.text: He takes a key off a string round his neck and holds it out. He doesn't follow you.

**Dr. Emmerich Aldersey:** "The ones that didn't take. They're still alive."

"Nobody's switched the lights off. That's how I know someone here still feels something."

He looks at you for a long moment. Then he takes off his badge, and goes down the floor opening every door.

**Dr. Emmerich Aldersey:** "Next region. Look under a rock. I'll find you."
**Dr. Emmerich Aldersey:** "Yes." He gives you the key. He goes back to his window.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Locked Laboratory

remembers.notice: *He was right. The lights are on. Someone kept them on.*

events.intro:
Tanks. In them, Pokémon mid-way through something. They turn their heads to follow you.

One tank glows a dark, wrong purple. The Pokémon inside it is a Shadow Pokémon. It presses one paw to the glass.

success.text:
The glass slides up. It steps out into the cold air and stands very close to you.

It doesn't trust you. It doesn't trust anyone. It comes anyway.
You leave the lights on.

events.name: {team} Hideout: Holding

remembers.notice: *One of them knows your lead. A kindness you did on some road, a long time ago. It comes to the bars first.*
*Alert: patrols. Torches sweep the pen. Nobody's talking their way past anyone now.*
*Alert 10. Every alarm in the building is going. Every Grunt left has called up one more Pokémon.*

events.intro:
Cages, stacked three high, labelled for shipping. A Chansey in the nearest one is trying to look after all of them through the bars.

The pen keeper, a tired {grunt} with a bucket of feed, steps in front of them. "Don't. I just feed them. Don't."

success.text: You open every cage. She drops the bucket and reaches for a Ball.

win.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text:
She looks at you for a long time. "...They bite the boss. They never bite me."

She hands you the keys, folds her jacket on the bucket, and helps you open every cage. Then she walks out with them.

effects.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

success.text: "Not with the alarms going," she says. "They'll know it was me." She puts the bucket down, and reaches for a Ball.

win.text: The camera's red light stays off. The loop is still running.
A camera turns, slowly, to follow you. (Alert +2)

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Vault
events.intro:
A round steel door, open. Inside, gold-coloured shelves and a desk. Behind the desk, {lt}.

**{lt}:** "You've cost us a floor of salaries. Do you know what a {grunt} *costs?* The hats alone."

success.text: {lt} stands, and straightens their cuffs.
{lt} snaps their fingers. Two {grunt}s step out from behind the shelves.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Vault
events.intro:
The two {grunt}s are down. {lt} hasn't moved from behind the desk.

**{lt}:** "Fine. I'll do it myself. I always do."

success.text: {lt} stands.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Vault Shelves
events.intro:
{lt} is gone, out a back door you didn't see. The shelves are full of things the team took.

You can carry one. Anything more and you won't make the stairs.

success.text: A Poké Ball in a velvet box, cold to the touch. It never asked to be like this. It comes with you.
A stone with a luggage label tied to it. A name and an address, in a child's writing.
An Egg in a padded crate stamped FRAGILE. Nobody has written what it is.

choices.label: A pass to the black market.

success.text: A plastic card with a red R on it. For the rest of the region, the night market will treat you as one of theirs.

events.name: {team} Hideout: The Luggage Label
events.intro: The label says who it belongs to. They live two towns back.

success.text: You post it back with a note. A week later a drawing finds you: you, a stone, and a very big smile.
You untie the label and put it in your pocket. The stone is yours now.

events.name: Someone You Freed
events.intro:
A wild Pokémon steps onto the path. It doesn't raise its hackles. It doesn't run.

It looks at you, and it nods, once. You were the one who opened the cage.

success.text: It turns, and goes back into the long grass. It knows where you are now.

events.name: Someone You Freed, Again
events.intro:
One of the Pokémon from the Hideout cages has been following you for a whole stage.

It finally comes close enough to touch. It sits down at your feet and waits.

success.text: It comes. It already knows your voice. (Bond +1)
It stays a moment longer. Then it goes, light-footed, the way free things go.

events.name: The Rescue Centre
events.intro:
A hand-painted sign by the road: *RESCUE CENTRE. ALL WELCOME. NO TEAMS.*

The nurse is a Chansey. You know her. She was in the nearest cage, looking after everyone through the bars.

success.text: She looks after your whole team, and won't take a thing for it. The ones you freed built the place themselves.

events.name: A Note Under a Rock
events.intro: A flat stone on a fence post, with a corner of paper sticking out from under it.

success.text: Folded small. It's signed E.A.

events.name: The Psyduck Migration

remembers.notice: **Mrs. Quimby:** "The bridge is out. Some fool went through it last week."

events.intro:
*Psyduck in the road. Psyduck in the fountain. A Psyduck on a roof, with no clear idea how.*

*A bench slides three feet to the left by itself. A lamp post bends, politely.*

**Mayor, Mrs. Quimby:** "They come through every year, on the way to the lake. They've always gone *round.* This year the bridge is out, so they've come *through,* and they've all got headaches."

**Mrs. Quimby:** "They'll follow anything that walks in a straight line. We haven't got anyone who can."

success.text: Mrs. Quimby claps her hands once. "Splendid. Mind the flower pots."
**Mrs. Quimby:** "They always have headaches, dear. It's what they *are.*"
You walk on. Behind you, a lamp post bends to let a Psyduck past.

events.name: The Lake
events.intro:
*The line reaches the water. One by one, they walk in. The headaches go.*

*Thirty Psyduck float, perfectly still, facing the same way.*

*One doesn't go in. It's the one that was at the very back. It's looking at you, and holding its head.*

success.text:
It walks into your arms and leans its whole head against you. It still hurts. It doesn't seem to mind so much now.

Mrs. Quimby presses a bottle of Ibuprofen into your hand. "For the little one. It isn't medicine, dear. It's a *gesture.*"

effects.text: Nothing knocked over. Mrs. Quimby gives you a Rare item from the town hall, and her own hat. It doesn't fit. She insists.
A few things knocked over. The town gives you a Berry bundle anyway, a little stiffly.
The wedding cake. Nothing extra. The couple are laughing about it, eventually.

choices.label: Let it find its own way in.

success.text: It looks at the water. It looks at you. In the end, it walks in backwards, still holding its head.

effects.text: Nothing knocked over. Mrs. Quimby gives you a Rare item from the town hall, and her own hat. It doesn't fit. She insists.
A few things knocked over. The town gives you a Berry bundle anyway, a little stiffly.
The wedding cake. Nothing extra. The couple are laughing about it, eventually.

choices.label: Leave them at the edge of town.

success.text: They sit down where you left them. The town walks them the rest of the way, slowly, one Psyduck at a time.
